```{r,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
estimate_causal_gcomp <- function(n_timepoints = 100, 
                                        n_per_time = 50,
                                        a_zx, a_zpz, b_yzp, b_yx,
                                        c_z, c_zp, c_y,
                                        sd_ez, sd_ezp) {
  
  total_n <- n_timepoints * n_per_time
  
  # Generate actual exposure values for each timepoint
  # X_t_actual <- rep(0,n_timepoints)
  X_t_actual <- runif(n_timepoints, 0, 3)
  # Timepoint index for aggregation
  timepoint_idx <- rep(1:n_timepoints, each = n_per_time)
  
  # Generate errors 
  eps_z <- rnorm(total_n, mean = 0, sd = sd_ez)
  eps_zp <- rnorm(total_n, mean = 0, sd = sd_ezp)
  
  # ===== do(X_t = X_t_actual) =====
  X_do0 <- rep(X_t_actual, each = n_per_time)
  Z_do0 <- a_zx * X_do0 + c_z + eps_z
  Zp_do0 <- a_zpz * Z_do0 + c_zp + eps_zp
  linear_pred_do0 <- b_yzp * Zp_do0 + b_yx * X_t_actual + c_y
  p_do0 <- plogis(linear_pred_do0)
  Y_ij_do0 <- rbinom(total_n, 1, p_do0)
  Y_t_do0 <- tapply(Y_ij_do0, timepoint_idx, sum)
  E_Y_do0 <- mean(Y_t_do0)
  
  # ===== do(X_t = X_t_actual + 1) =====
  # Shift exposure up by 1 for each timepoint
  X_do1 <- rep(X_t_actual + 1, each = n_per_time)
  Z_do1 <- a_zx * X_do1 + c_z + eps_z
  Zp_do1 <- a_zpz * Z_do1 + c_zp + eps_zp
  linear_pred_do1 <- b_yzp * Zp_do1 + b_yx * (X_t_actual + 1) + c_y
  p_do1 <- plogis(linear_pred_do1)
  Y_ij_do1 <- rbinom(total_n, 1, p_do1)
  Y_t_do1 <- tapply(Y_ij_do1, timepoint_idx, sum)
  E_Y_do1 <- mean(Y_t_do1)
  
  # Causal effect: average effect of increasing X by 1
  causal_effect <- log(E_Y_do1) - log(E_Y_do0)
  
  return(causal_effect)
}
```

```{r}
# Parameters
a_zx <- 0.9; a_zpz <- 1.0; b_yzp <- -0.8; b_yx <- 0.5
c_z <- 0.1; c_zp <- 0.3; c_y <- -4
sd_ez <- 0.5; sd_ezp <- 0.4

# Theoretical true total causal effect
alpha <- a_zpz * a_zx
T_true <- b_yx + b_yzp * alpha
```

```{r}
# Data generating function
generate_data <- function(n_timepoints = 100, n_per_time = 50) {
  total_n <- n_timepoints * n_per_time
  X_t <- runif(n_timepoints, 0, 3)
  X <- rep(X_t, each = n_per_time)
  timepoint_idx <- rep(1:n_timepoints, each = n_per_time)
  
  eps_z <- rnorm(total_n, 0, sd_ez)
  eps_zp <- rnorm(total_n, 0, sd_ezp)
  
  Z <- a_zx * X + c_z + eps_z
  Zp <- a_zpz * Z + c_zp + eps_zp
  linear_pred <- b_yzp * Zp + b_yx * X + c_y
  Y_ij <- rbinom(total_n, 1, plogis(linear_pred))
  Y_t <- tapply(Y_ij, timepoint_idx, sum)
  
  return(data.frame(timepoint = 1:n_timepoints, X = X_t, Y = Y_t, n = n_per_time))
}

# Estimate marginalized effect
estimate_marginalized <- function(data) {
  fit <- glm(Y ~ X, data = data, family = poisson(), offset = log(n))
  return(coef(fit)["X"])
}

# Run simulation
run_simulation <- function(n_reps = 200, n_timepoints = 100, n_per_time = 50) {
  
  results <- data.frame(
    rep = 1:n_reps,
    marginalized_effect = NA_real_,
    causal_effect = NA_real_
  )
  
  for (rep in 1:n_reps) {
    if (rep %% 50 == 0) cat("Replication", rep, "of", n_reps, "\n")
    
    # Generate data
    data <- generate_data(n_timepoints, n_per_time)
    
    # Marginalized effect
    results$marginalized_effect[rep] <- estimate_marginalized(data)
    
    # Causal effect (using corrected function with x_ref = mean X)
    # x_ref <- mean(data$X)
    results$causal_effect[rep] <- estimate_causal_gcomp(
      n_timepoints = n_timepoints,
      n_per_time = n_per_time,
      # x_ref = x_ref,
      a_zx = a_zx, a_zpz = a_zpz, b_yzp = b_yzp, b_yx = b_yx,
      c_z = c_z, c_zp = c_zp, c_y = c_y,
      sd_ez = sd_ez, sd_ezp = sd_ezp
    )
  }
  
  return(results)
}
```
```{r, results='hide', fig.show='hide'}
# Run
set.seed(42)
cat("Running simulation...\n")
sim_results <- run_simulation(n_reps = 5000, n_timepoints = 100, n_per_time = 80)

# Summary
summary_stats <- sim_results %>%
  summarise(
    marg_mean = mean(marginalized_effect, na.rm = TRUE),
    marg_sd = sd(marginalized_effect, na.rm = TRUE),
    causal_mean = mean(causal_effect, na.rm = TRUE),
    causal_sd = sd(causal_effect, na.rm = TRUE),
    diff_mean = mean(marginalized_effect - causal_effect, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
summary_stats
```
```{r, echo = FALSE}
cat("\n========== RESULTS ==========\n")
cat("Theoretical True EFFECT:", T_true, "\n")
cat("Marginalized mean:", round(summary_stats$marg_mean, 4), "\n")
cat("Causal mean:", round(summary_stats$causal_mean, 4), "\n")
cat("Difference:", round(summary_stats$diff_mean, 4), "\n")
cat("=============================\n")
```
```{r}
# Histogram
sim_results_long <- sim_results %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(marginalized_effect, causal_effect),
               names_to = "effect_type",
               values_to = "estimate")

ggplot(sim_results_long, aes(x = estimate, fill = effect_type)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.6, bins = 40, position = "identity") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = T_true, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Causal vs Marginalized Effect",
       x = "Estimate", y = "Count", fill = "Effect") +
  theme_minimal()





```
